cohort: 369 primigravidae, 15-35 years old with singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation and with height less than 152 cm
finding: Emergency cesarean section was more common in short statured primigravidae.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery occurred in 26.02%, instrumental vaginal delivery in 8.67% (vacuum 3.52%, forceps 5.15%), elective cesarean section in 7.59%, and emergency cesarean section in 56.09% of short-statured primigravidae.
